pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions. The edge geometry is characterized by moderate pixel gradients and irregular angularity. The spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous system of light cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is variable, showing narrowing at points of close patch proximity and widening at junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dense, dark, bristly mane along the dorsal ridge of the neck. The 1D geometric contour exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated pattern with visible vertical pixel filaments against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, localized pixel clusters with distinct yellow and dark segments, representing avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the lateral surface of the neck and shoulder.
